incident_text: A building is burning and firefighters are working on it.

result.scene_summary: Firefighters are battling a large fire engulfing a house, with thick black smoke rising into the sky. The building appears to be on a grassy slope.

observations.description: Large, dense, dark grey smoke billowing from the house.
Bright orange flames visible on the right side of the house, through openings in the roof and wall.
Three figures in firefighter gear standing on a grassy slope, operating a hose.
A house with partially collapsed or damaged sections, showing exposed walls and windows.
Trees and bushes surrounding the house, with a grassy slope in the foreground.
Signs of fire damage to the roof and walls, including missing or broken sections.
